'''Jimmy Schiemer''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd or 3rd (author unsure) at [[June 2000 Framingham tournament]] on 3 June 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down/Dueling w/odds]] and Yavin 4 Throne Room w/Revolutions, according to Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d845">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-06-framingham-ma-6-3-2000d845/ framingham-ma-6-3-2000], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 6 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-06-framingham-ma-6-3-2000d845/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
